entities.summary: Ennis Whatley is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Kansas City Kings in the first round of the 1983 NBA draft. Whatley played in ten National Basketball Association (NBA) seasons. A 6-foot-3-inch (1.91 m), 177-pound (80 kg) guard, he played for the Chicago Bulls, the Cleveland Cavaliers, Washington Bullets, San Antonio Spurs, Atlanta Hawks, Los Angeles Clippers and Portland Trail Blazers.
